name: What are the common challenges to expect during a home addition project?

mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges to expect during a home addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges during a home addition project can include unexpected structural issues in the existing home, weather delays, unforeseen soil conditions, or changes requested by the homeowner mid-project. Permitting delays from local authorities can also impact timelines. Effective communication with your general contractor is key to navigating these challenges. A reputable contractor, like Simply Construction, plans for contingencies, communicates transparently, and works to resolve issues efficiently to keep the project on track and within budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect potential challenges like unexpected structural issues, weather delays, permitting delays, and mid-project changes. Good communication with your contractor is vital for resolution.
